text:
olivia_support: FYI VantageHealth procurement is rejecting our invoice until they have an official vendor PO in their SAP format. Portal error attached. we're blocked from issuing the final invoice

jasper_sales: Who's the procurement contact? i can ping them. did they share the expected PO format?

olivia_support: They said the PO must match `VH-PO-YYYY-####` exactly. Portal shows: 
```
ERROR 400: Invalid PO format
Expected regex: ^VH-PO-\d{4}-\d{4}$
Received: PO123456
```

mike_billing: We can't send a final invoice without that PO. We can produce a proforma but their AP team refuses proformas for payment routing.

sara_procurement: From their note: invoice needs `po_number` and `cost_center` metadata fields, and the invoice file must include vendor W-9 + signed SOW in attachments. otherwise portal rejects upload. :warning:

olivia_support: can someone confirm we have W-9 + signed SOW on file for VantageHealth (acct: VH-321)? i couldn't find signed SOW in contract folder.

jasper_sales: i'll check and DM legal. procurement lead is @mark_vh. pinging him now — will ask for official PO + cost center string.

accounting-bot: Proforma created: INV-PROFORMA-2026-3345 - https://billing.redwood.ai/inv/INV-PROFORMA-2026-3345 (expires in 7 days)

mike_billing: once we get the PO we can re-issue final invoice with `po_number` and `cost_center` in the invoice header. please confirm the exact PO value and cost center code to avoid another rejection.

jasper_sales: update from Mark: "we'll issue PO by EOD. format will be `VH-PO-2026-0789`. cost_center = CC-4302. also vendor code must be `RVW001` in the header."

olivia_support: great — once PO arrives i'll attach it here and reopen the billing job. note from their portal team: invoice date must match PO effective date or upload fails.

mike_billing: noted. after PO + attachments (W-9 + SOW) are in our system i'll generate INV-2026-3345-final and submit to portal. ETA ~24h from receipt of PO.

jasper_sales: legal confirmed signed SOW uploaded to /contracts/VH-321/SOW_signed.pdf and W-9 uploaded to /contracts/VH-321/W9.pdf. i've attached both to this thread. :thumbsup:

olivia_support: perfect. leaving a short repro for eng if portal errors persist:
1) upload invoice PDF -> portal returns 400 with message above
2) upload invoice plus `po_number` and `cost_center` metadata -> success 200
3) if attachments missing -> fails with "missing required attachment: W-9 or SOW"

mike_billing: thanks. i'll queue final invoice generation once i see the PO ID in the customer reply.

jasper_sales: mark replied with the official PO: `VH-PO-2026-0789`. he's copied procurement email to me.

olivia_support: re-opened billing flow and attached PO + docs to ticket. accounting-bot, please swap proforma -> final when ready.

accounting-bot: Noted. Will create final invoice INV-2026-3345-FINAL once requested by @mike_billing.

mike_billing: created final invoice INV-2026-3345-FINAL with PO `VH-PO-2026-0789`, cost_center `CC-4302`, vendor_code `RVW001`. submitting to portal now.

accounting-bot: Submission status: 202 Accepted -> Processing. portal response: 200 OK -> Accepted for payment.

olivia_support: resolved on our side. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
